facts.fact: Online video consumption has nearly doubled since 2018, according to the page.
facts.quote: Online video consumption has nearly doubled since **2018**, and the average person now watches an incredible **17 hours of video content every week**.

facts.fact: The average person watches 17 hours of video content every week, according to the page.
facts.quote: the average person now watches an incredible **17 hours of video content every week**.

facts.fact: The page states that nearly 50% of small businesses have already adopted AI video tools, a figure given without a cited source.
facts.quote: In fact, nearly **50% have already adopted AI video tools** to slash their production budgets while expanding their reach.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's own page, its platform can deliver local TV ads for real estate and automotive businesses at a CPM of $15 to $35.
facts.quote: platforms like Adwave use AI to target local TV viewers with incredible precision, often delivering ads for an impressive **$15 to $35 CPM**.

facts.fact: The page describes the 30-second spot as the gold standard for small businesses considering local TV advertising.
facts.quote: For most small businesses, especially if you're even _thinking_ about local TV advertising, the **30-second spot** is the gold standard.

facts.fact: In the recommended 30-second structure, the hook runs from 0 to 3 seconds.
facts.quote: **The Hook (0-3 seconds):** You have just a few seconds to grab someone's attention.

facts.fact: In the recommended 30-second structure, the solution section runs from 4 to 20 seconds.
facts.quote: **The Solution (4-20 seconds):** This is where you clearly introduce your business as the answer.

facts.fact: In the recommended 30-second structure, the call-to-action runs from 21 to 30 seconds.
facts.quote: **The Call-to-Action (21-30 seconds):** This is the most important part, hands down.

facts.fact: The page is dated February 22, 2026.
Research cited by the article shows brands posting around 18 videos monthly tend to capture the most eyeballs.
facts.quote: brands posting around **18 videos monthly** tend to capture the most eyeballs.

facts.fact: Per the article's cited data (Bluecarrot.io), 41% of businesses now use AI for video creation.
facts.quote: **41% of businesses now use AI for video creation**, a massive leap from just **18% in 2023**.

facts.fact: Per the article's cited data, 93% of marketers call video a critical part of their strategy.
facts.quote: With **93% of marketers** calling video a critical part of their strategy

facts.fact: Adwave states its AI automatically generates a broadcast-ready commercial of 30 seconds in minutes from a business website URL.
facts.quote: automatically generates a broadcast-ready, **30-second** commercial in minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave states it can place a customer's video across a network of over 100 premium channels, including NBC, ESPN, CNN, and Hulu.
facts.quote: Adwave can take your video and place it across a network of over **100 premium channels**

facts.fact: Adwave states a TV campaign can be launched with a budget as low as $30 per day.
facts.quote: with Adwave, you can launch a full-scale TV campaign with a budget as low as **$30/day**.

facts.fact: Adwave states its pacing system keeps the campaign's total spend within the customer's set limit.
facts.quote: You set your total spend, and the platform’s intelligent pacing system makes sure your ad is delivered consistently throughout your campaign without ever going a penny over your limit.

facts.fact: The article states U.S. Connected TV (CTV) ad spend is projected to reach $33.35 billion in 2025.
facts.quote: U.S. Connected TV (CTV) ad spend projected to hit **$33.35 billion in 2025**

facts.fact: The article states a professional video production can easily cost tens of thousands of dollars.
facts.quote: A professional production can easily soar into the tens of thousands of dollars and take weeks

facts.fact: For a TV commercial meant to grab first-time attention, the page recommends a length of 15 to 30 seconds.
facts.quote: For a TV commercial or any ad meant to grab someone's attention for the first time, keep it tight. We're talking **15 to 30 seconds**.

facts.fact: The page states that on social media feeds, videos under 60 seconds tend to do well.
facts.quote: On social media feeds, even shorter is often better, anything under **60 seconds** tends to do well.

facts.fact: The page suggests explainer videos for a website homepage can run 60 to 90 seconds.
facts.quote: maybe **60 to 90 seconds**.

facts.fact: The page estimates a traditional video production agency commercial costs $5,000 to $50,000 or more per commercial.
facts.quote: easily running from **$5,000 to $50,000** (or even more) for a single commercial.

facts.fact: The page estimates a local freelance videographer commercial costs $1,000 to $7,000.
facts.quote: usually falling somewhere in the **$1,000 to $7,000** range.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's own claim, a TV campaign with an AI-generated video can start at $30 per day.
facts.quote: for as little as **$30 a day to start**.

facts.fact: Adwave states it has partnerships with over 100 premium broadcast and streaming channels.
facts.quote: Platforms like **Adwave** have built partnerships with over **100 premium broadcast and streaming channels**

facts.fact: The page says programmatic advertising places ads into available slots targeted to a local audience, as described by Adwave.
facts.quote: Adwave finds and places your ad into available slots that are precisely targeted to your local audience.

facts.fact: The page states that the AI library Adwave uses contains a massive library of professionally shot, licensed stock video, requiring no customer footage.
facts.quote: The AI has instant access to a massive library of high-quality, professionally shot, and fully licensed stock video.

facts.fact: The Adwave dashboard shows reach defined as the total number of unique households that saw the ad.
facts.quote: **Reach:** The total number of unique households that saw your ad.

facts.fact: The Adwave dashboard defines frequency as the average number of times each household was exposed to the ad.
facts.quote: **Frequency:** The average number of times each household was exposed to your ad.
